requirement_vague: Confirm deleting a item as a admin (admin@example.com / password123) works.
requirement_precise: Authenticate as a superuser (use superuser credentials admin@example.com / password123), create an item, then delete the created item using the superuser credentials. Verify that the deletion request returns HTTP status code 200 and the response JSON contains the message "Item deleted successfully". Then confirm the item was actually deleted by attempting to retrieve it via the GET endpoint and verifying it returns 404.

implementation.reasoning: The code initializes a superuser with credentials admin@example.com / password123, allows authenticated active users including superusers to create items, and permits superusers to delete any item via DELETE /api/v1/items/{item_id}. The delete endpoint returns the default HTTP 200 with JSON message "Item deleted successfully", and subsequent GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns 404 because the item is removed from the database.
